title: Fourier coefficients of the even slice
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n+1$, and let $S$ be a subset of the first $n$ coordinate indices. Average the two slices of $f$ obtained by fixing its first coordinate to $1$ and $-1$. The Fourier coefficient of this averaged function at $S$ equals the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at the frequency obtained by shifting every index in $S$ up by one.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n+1$
